prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render a polished actual desktop application page edge to edge at 1536x1024 landscape, no browser/device frame. Use the attached approved review screen as the strict visual system: compact 68px horizontal header with Private Client Graph brand, Matters as the only primary navigation and neutral account icon; thin synthetic-only notice strip; paper #F6F6F1, white work areas, deep green #173E38, rules #C9CEC8, muted #59655F, burgundy #773B46 only for focus/destructive actions, gold only for source Evidence highlights. Newsreader-like serif titles, Public Sans-like body and controls. No invented profile, timestamps, owners, status chips, tabs, metrics, cards, shadows or decorative art. Match reference spacing, type sizes, simple squared buttons and precise rules. All content explicitly fictional. Create the intake form view, a focused dedicated page. Main content around 1120px wide, heading 'Create Matter' after 'Back to Matters'. Intro 'Upload one synthetic PDF. Review the proposed relationships before creating the Matter.' Form occupies left 740px with a quiet right column 260px containing only explanatory guidance, separated by space, no card. Form first heading 'Matter details' with thin horizontal rule. Two labelled white outlined text inputs side by side: 'External Matter reference' filled 'SYN-2026-014', helper 'Use the reference from your existing Matter system.'; 'Matter title' filled 'Evergreen family trust'. Next section heading 'Source document'. A plain outlined white file-selection row, small document icon, filename 'fictional-attendance-note.pdf', text 'PDF selected', secondary button 'Change PDF'. No fake upload progress or retained-file download link. Below file row concise guidance 'One text-layer PDF · Up to 10 MiB and 50 pages' then smaller 'Scanned and encrypted PDFs are not supported. Extracted text: up to 100,000 characters.' Then full-width text input label 'Source title', value 'Fictional attendance note', helper 'This title will appear beside the source evidence.' Below: checked checkbox and exact sentence 'I confirm this material is synthetic or fictional and contains no real confidential client information.' At bottom dark green 'Upload and analyse' button and secondary 'Back to Matters'; under controls 'Keep this page open during analysis. A proposal is saved only after analysis succeeds.' Right guidance column heading 'What happens next', three short ordinary paragraphs with no stepper: 'We extract the text from your PDF.' 'You review the proposed graph against the exact source evidence.' 'You decide whether to accept the whole proposal.' One small secondary underlined 'Need something to try?' link with sentence 'Get a prompt for creating a fictional source.' Footer boundary. Entire form fits naturally in 1024px without tiny text, aligned labels, 44px minimum controls. No drag-drop gimmick, no editing tools, no source preview or graphs on intake.
reference: Selected graph-led Matter Ledger direction; see ../../practitioner-matter-workflow-design.md.
approval: Approved by the product owner in the Matter workflow design session.
